pairs.subject: native-document-format
pairs.evidence: src/features/agents/sub_editor/libs/useEditorSave.ts:185 The editor saves by sending typed PersonaOperation ops through the agent store into the app's SQLite rows. It never writes a document file. A search of components/, hooks/ and libs/ found no writeFile, showSaveFilePicker, format_version/formatVersion or schemaVersion. The one portable artifact it touches (the .persona.json gallery bundle) is serialized behind a backend command, not in this context.

techniques.evidence: src/features/agents/sub_editor/components/ShareAgentButton.tsx:49 The only file that leaves the machine, the .persona.json bundle, is built by the Rust command gallery_publish_persona. This context only triggers it, so the bundle's generation stamp cannot be judged here.

src/features/agents/sub_editor/libs/useEditorSave.ts:49 The only serialization here is a model_profile JSON blob stored in a DB column, not a document file. JSON.stringify does not depend on locale anyway.
